Applications must be submitted online on or before 06-10-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of NHSRC to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the NHSRC Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 06-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of NHSRC to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NHSRC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications for the NHSRC Consultant / Senior Consultant (NUHM) posts is 06 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Post-graduation or higher qualification in Public health, Community health, Preventive & Social Medicine or Administration, along with relevant post-qualification experience.

faq.question: Q3. What is the maximum age limit for the applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the posts is 50 years.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for NHSRC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST).

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for these positions?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Written Test followed by an Interview.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary range for the Consultant post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Consultant post ranges from Rs.60,000/- to Rs.1,20,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary range for the Senior Consultant post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Senior Consultant post ranges from Rs.90,000/- to Rs.1,50,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q8. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Consultant post and one vacancy for the Senior Consultant post, totaling 2 vacancies.

faq.question: Q9. What is the mode of application for NHSRC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through the official website or the provided link.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF link is available in the Important Links section of this article.
